iconPrefix: 2D side-scrolling game world prop (no people, no hands, no characters), a single object centered, seen from the side at a slight high angle like a 2.5D street brawler, mature graphic-novel cel-shaded style, thick confident black ink outlines, two-tone hard-edged shadows, gritty worn texture, muted desaturated palette of olive, rust, bone and slate with a sparing accent colour, grounded and realistic, not cartoony.

sprites.prompt: a belt-fed light machine gun on its own, perfectly horizontal strict side profile pointing to the right, ventilated barrel shroud, carrying handle, feed tray cover with a short brass ammunition belt hanging from the left side, wooden stock on the left, no tripod, no stand.

a machine-gun nest emplacement without the gun: a curved low wall of stacked burlap sandbags, and rising from behind it a squat steel tripod mount with a pintle cradle at its top, an olive ammo can on the bags, side view.
a scoped bolt-action deer hunting rifle on its own with a walnut stock and a long blued barrel, perfectly horizontal strict side profile pointing to the right, sling hanging loose, no stand.
a sturdy square timber fence post driven into the ground with a welded steel swivel fork yoke bolted on its top, a couple of sandbags piled at its foot, side view, tall and narrow.

an improvised flame projector lance on its own: a long blackened steel pipe nozzle with a pilot-light burner at the tip, a brass valve and a pistol grip, a rubber hose coiling off the left end, perfectly horizontal strict side profile pointing to the right.

two white scuffed barbecue propane tanks strapped to a rusty two-wheel hand truck dolly, red rubber hoses and a pressure regulator gauge, a short steel pipe stand with a swivel clamp sticking up from the top, side view.

a yellow and black pneumatic framing nail gun on its own with a long strip magazine of nails and an air hose, mounted on a short steel bracket, perfectly horizontal strict side profile with the nose pointing to the right.

an automatic nail turret stand without the gun: a rusty old tractor seat swivel pedestal on a steel pipe post welded to a heavy base plate, a grey metal relay box with a red indicator lamp and bundled wires zip-tied to the post, a small air compressor tank at its foot, side view.
a low wide firing step made of three rows of stacked burlap sandbags on a wooden pallet, side view, long and low, slightly dirty and sagging.

a makeshift wooden scaffold tower platform: rough timber legs with diagonal cross bracing, a plank deck on top with a row of sandbags along its front edge, a short ladder leaning on one side, side view, wider than tall.

a row of sharpened rusty rebar spikes welded to a horizontal steel angle-iron rail, all spikes angled up and to the right, side view, wide and low.
a tall thin weathered wooden pole with a pair of halogen work floodlights on a crossbar at the top, an orange extension cord taped down the pole, side view, very tall and very narrow.
a small low heap of two dead zombie bodies lying tangled on each other, grey skin, torn dirty clothes, limp limbs, dark dried blood, side view, low and wide.

a heap of four or five dead zombie bodies piled against each other, grey skin, torn dirty clothes, limp arms and legs sticking out, dark dried blood, side view, wider than tall, sloping down to the right.
a large tall mound of many dead zombie bodies piled up, grey skin, torn dirty clothes, limp arms and legs sticking out everywhere, dark dried blood, side view, sloping down to the right, grim.
an open storm drain opening set flat in cracked asphalt, a dark square hole with a broken concrete rim, seen from a low three-quarter angle so it looks flat and wide.
a heavy rusty cast-iron storm drain grate lying flat on the ground, parallel iron bars, seen from a low three-quarter angle so it looks flat and wide.
a waist-high heap of road junk used as cover: a detached house door, two old car tires, a shopping cart tipped on its side, broken planks and a bent street sign, side view, wider than tall.
